parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The snapshot ID. After you successfully create a snapshot for an Advanced Extreme NAS file system by calling [CreateSnapshot](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-createsnapshot), call [DescribeSnapshots](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/nas/developer-reference/api-nas-2017-06-26-describesnapshots) (with FileSystemType set to extreme) to query the snapshot list and obtain the snapshot ID.
